summary: Add the per-link click limit with a nullable AddMaxClicks migration
rationale: Retry after the gate failed: the previous migration declared MaxClicks NOT NULL, so every link without a limit failed to insert (SQLite Error 19). The column is now nullable, matching the model (null = unlimited).
content:
# Implementation

Domain, application, API and migration changes as designed. The migration adds a nullable column so existing rows remain unlimited.
